title: Polymarket Predicts Madison Huang as NVIDIA CEO’s Top Successor
text:
Polymarket Predicts Madison Huang as NVIDIA CEO’s Top Successor | KuCoin Home News Details Polymarket Predicts Madison Huang as NVIDIA CEO’s Top Successor 
 币界网 Release Time: 2026/11/12 02:50:33 Share NVDA -- -- CROSS $0.1061 3.46% Summary Polymarket lists Madison Huang as the top altcoin market favorite to succeed NVIDIA’s CEO. As Senior Director of Physical AI Product Marketing, she leads Omniverse initiatives for robotics and industrial applications. A former employee noted that her cross-functional role indicates leadership readiness. No official succession plan has been announced. Price predictions for top altcoins remain speculative amid ongoing market trends. CoinDesk reports: IT Home, November 12: Market speculation over the next CEO of NVIDIA continues to intensify. Today, November 12, the prediction market platform Polymarket posted a tweet stating that Madison Huang, the daughter of Jensen Huang, has become the "leading candidate" to succeed him as NVIDIA's CEO.
 IT Home’s review of public information shows that Polymarket is a prediction market company founded in 2020 by Shayne Coplan and headquartered in New York, which turns the outcomes of future events into tradable contracts. Users can buy and sell contracts based on events such as elections, sports matches, economic indicators, and cryptocurrency prices, with platform prices reflecting traders’ collective judgments on these outcomes.
 Minshan Huang currently serves as Senior Director of Product Marketing for NVIDIA’s Physical AI products, working on platforms such as Omniverse for robotics and industrial applications. According to Business Insider, a former employee observed that Huang is increasingly involved in cross-business matters, potentially preparing for broader management responsibilities. However, this is based on the respondent’s observation and not an officially confirmed promotion or succession plan by the company.
